title: Projects
text:
This portfolio highlights selected academic projects demonstrating my experience with business analytics, data analysis, visualization, and data-driven decision making.


Boston University — Big Data and Cloud Analytics for Business
Developed a career evaluation product using job-posting data to analyze opportunities for Data Scientists within the Software Publishers industry.
Key areas of analysis include:

Job-market demand and employer activity
Salary and geographic trends
Experience and education requirements
Remote-work patterns
Technical skill demand
Skill-gap analysis and career recommendations

Tools: Python, Pandas, Plotly, Quarto, GitHub, GitHub Pages

View GitHub Repository



Through my graduate coursework at Boston University Metropolitan College, I have completed projects involving data preparation, exploratory analysis, visualization, and statistical and analytical methods.
My coursework has provided hands-on experience using tools such as Python, SQL, R, Power BI, Tableau, and Excel to translate data into useful business insights.

title: About Me
text:
I am a marketing professional currently working as a Marketing Coordinator at HH Brown Work & Outdoor Group, where I support marketing initiatives across multiple footwear brands and work closely with sales, design, product, and other cross-functional teams.
I earned my B.S. in Marketing from Penn State University’s Smeal College of Business, with a minor in Sports Studies. I am currently continuing my education at Boston University Metropolitan College, where I am developing my skills in business analytics and data-driven decision making.
